Class RMIServer

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckerproject.network.RMI.Server.RMIServer
All Implemented Interfaces:
Server
public class RMIServer extends Object implements Server
This class sets up and runs an RMI server for the Galaxy Trucker game. It binds the controller factory to the RMI registry so clients can connect to the server.

  • Method Details

    • connect

      public void connect(String ip, MultiGameController multiGameController)
      Establishes the RMI connection and binds the controller factory to the RMI registry. This method sets up an RMI registry on a specific port (default 1099), creates a `ControllerFactory` object, and binds it to the RMI registry so that clients can access the server functionality. It also starts the ping-pong mechanism to keep the connection alive.
      Specified by:
      connect in interface Server
      Parameters:
      multiGameController - The controller that manages multiple game sessions.
